products.title: The 63 | Fyfe Golf Event
products.body_html:
THE 63: Across the links of the Causeway Coast

This October, The 63 brings Fyfe Golf and Top100GolfCourses.com to Northern Ireland for 63 holes across four courses in two days — a journey through Castlerock and Portstewart, and two very different days of links golf on the North Coast.

Day one begins at Castlerock, with nine holes on the Bann before heading back out for 18 on the Mussenden. The following morning, we move along the coast to Portstewart, taking on the Old Course before finishing The 63 among the towering dunes of the Strand.

In partnership with Top100GolfCourses.com and Marine & Lawn, and hosted alongside Jasper Miners of Top100, this is a gathering built around the simplest part of the game — playing good courses, in good company, from one round to the next.

Welcome to The 63.
Four courses. Two clubs. Two days on the North Coast.

Your place includes:

– 63 holes across four courses
– Bann & Mussenden at Castlerock
– Old & Strand at Portstewart
– Fyfe Golf player welcome pack
– Competition & prizes

£100 per player

An optional post-round gathering at Marine & Lawn is planned for Friday evening, with drinks and dinner available separately. Full details will be shared with players ahead of the event.

24 spaces available.
